steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Both Christianity and Islam generally condemn violence, terrorism and unjust war — but both traditions have teachings about when force may be justified. | RS Exam Tips — Violence, Terrorism and War: 1. For Violence, Terrorism and War questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Violence, Terrorism and War to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
